hanh_dong.code:
def thue_tncn(thu_nhap, giam_tru=11000000):
    tn_chiu_thue = max(0, thu_nhap - giam_tru)
    if tn_chiu_thue <= 5000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.05
    elif tn_chiu_thue <= 10000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.1 - 250000
    elif tn_chiu_thue <= 18000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.15 - 750000
    elif tn_chiu_thue <= 32000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.2 - 1650000
    elif tn_chiu_thue <= 52000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.25 - 3250000
    elif tn_chiu_thue <= 80000000: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.3 - 5850000
    else: return tn_chiu_thue * 0.35 - 9850000
